about_the_game:
ZENVADER is a bullet-hell roguelite shooter inspired by classic shooting games in the 80s.

You pilot a “Battle Unit”, the last hope for mankind, and take on an army of powerful aliens.

Four Battle Units

There are four types of battle units that you can pilot: a unit that excels in rapid fire, a unit that excels in penetrating ability and destructive power, a unit that fights using indirect means such as wall shot and missiles, and so on. Each unit has its own characteristics and requires different strategies.

Take Orbs to Power Up

Your unit is weak at first, but by taking orbs dropped by the aliens, you can temporarily enhance its rapid-firing speed, movement speed, damage dealt, and so on.

Unlock Skills at Space Hangar

By spending “Alien Materia” acquired by defeating aliens, you can unlock new skills and permanently increase various parameters. The more you fight, the stronger you become, and eventually you will be able to defeat the foes that you thought you could never defeat.
